frozen ContextSnapshot
holds EVERYTHING - policy numbers,
every Coverage figure

span.p:
may_disclose_policy_details
= assurance is L2 or better

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WITHHELD RENDER
- policy number replaced by
'มีกรมธรรม์ที่เกี่ยวข้อง (ยังไม่ยืนยันตัวตน)'
- verify-identity PREPENDED as action 0
- every L2-gated playbook step DROPPED
- degraded = LOW_ASSURANCE

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FULL RENDER
- policy number shown
- coverage figures shown
- full playbook

div.style: color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
agent confirms identity,
or a typed policy number matches (D42/D43)

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
this is a RE-RENDER, not a re-fetch.
The data was already in memory.
No round trip to the bank core.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GATE AT THE WIRE, SERVER-SIDE
send only what this level permits.
Never ship the full brief and hide
fields in React - devtools defeats that.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the LLM is not even imported here (D16)
every figure is read from a typed Coverage field,
so there is no code path that could put an
invented number on an insurance screen
